[quote=orphogron;59480656]Expansion Post:
Orphogronian forces came within range of the capital, Arnoc. Enemy resistance restricted them from getting any closer, but they prepared to bomb and bombard the city if need be. Luckily, it did not come to that. The rebels and their leaders evacuated, and they are still being tracked. As the liberators marched victoriously through the city, there were minor skirmishes, and some bombs were dropped by the escapees' planes, but most of the rebels had surrendered or escaped. Indeed, many of the conscripted recruits were grateful to surrender and even helped defeat some rebels. Congress reconvened and decided that, "As this war scarred our nation greatly," said a Uiop politician, "We must take new measures to recover and stabilize further." In the end, it was decreed that Orphogron would expand into the south and acquire much-needed territory and resources, especially uranium and iron. Also, the fleeing rebels had harassed and attacked rural populations, and expanding would intimidate and drive away militias. Also, the rebels had left a trail of destruction in their wake, and the country was receiving many new immigrants. This created a newfound need for space and also is driving us to expand. Furthermore, the new immigrants and  economic deals made by many of our companies that definitely have no part in our governing are boosting our economy.
